items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Remember when Tyree Glenn had the broken leg on the road with Duke... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I think I remember that.

ctx.x: And he said he would put his fork down and all he heard was the plate, you know. There was no food on the plate.
Remember when Tyree Glenn had the broken leg on the road with Duke, and he was out there playing the vibes with his leg in a cast -- I think it was about 1950 or so.
Yeah, I think I remember that.
